title: Create: Automation Consistency
description: A few recipes for Create mod to make automation more consistent and allow a few things to be automated.
body:
Create: Automation Consistency adds several recipes to improve automation with Create. It aims to be less overpowered than alternatives like Create: Ultimate Factory, and intentionally leaves some things un-automatable (e.g. netherrack and diamonds).

It adds/modifies the following recipes:

### Crushing
- Basalt -> 15% chance for gunpowder, 15% chance for Crushed Raw Zinc
- Stone -> Cobblestone
- Deepslate -> Cobbled Deepslate, 50% chance for Nugget of Experience
- Dripstone -> 3-4 Pointed Dripstone, 20% chance for a Copper Nugget (in default Create, it yields one Clay instead)
- Infested Stone -> Cobblestone, 50% chance for Nugget of Experience
- Infested Deepslate -> Cobbled Deepslate, 50% chance for Nugget of Experience
- Sculk -> 66% chance for Nugget of Experience
- Other Sculk blocks -> 3-4 Nuggets of Experience
- All Concrete -> respective color of Concrete Powder

### Haunting
- Basalt -> Blackstone
- Spider Eye -> Fermented Spider Eye
- Grass -> Mycelium
- Poppy -> Wither Rose
- Cobblestone -> Infested Cobblestone

Note that in Create, haunting Cobblestone normally yields Blackstone, while haunting Stone yields Infested Stone. With Automation Consistency, haunting Cobblestone infests it to match Stone's behavior, and haunting Basalt is the new way to get Blackstone.

### Mixing
- Sand + Charcoal + Cinder Flour -> Gunpowder
- Basalt + Gravel (heated) -> Tuff

### Pressing
- Soul Sand -> Soul Soil

### Washing
- Lava Bucket -> Obsidian + Bucket

### Deploying
- Deploying Polished Rose Quartz onto Iron Sheet -> Electron Tube

### Freezing (requires Create: Dragons Plus)
- Honey Bucket -> Honey Block + Bucket
- Water Bucket -> Ice + Bucket
- Lava Bucket -> Obsidian + Bucket
